program: Wingless external raw-input to repaired multi-step prediction to bounded refined abstract reasoning
question: Does one fixed training-only refinement of the abstract readout expose predictive gains that the sealed three-class COMMON/MID/RARE readout hides?
hypothesis: Keep the sealed 512-motif representation and supported repaired relation byte-identical in semantics, but replace only the frozen 3-class commonality readout with eight equal 64-motif frequency-rank classes computed from training prefixes. On the same untouched heldout depth-2/depth-3 queries, the repaired distribution will improve pooled depth-3 refined-class accuracy by at least 0.005 over the unrepaired baseline, will not degrade depth-2 refined-class accuracy by more than 0.005, will remain within 0.005 of or exceed its repaired top-1 class projection control, and will reduce the fraction of exact repair-gain queries hidden by the readout to at most 0.75.

prior_evidence.diagnosis: The relation repair improves exact prediction and aggregation is not the limiting factor, but 95.08% of exact repair gains are invisible under the three-class readout. The next bounded intervention changes only readout granularity.

scope_statement: This tests whether a fixed finer training-derived abstraction can convert already-supported predictive gains into downstream abstract-query gains. It does not add relation state, semantic labels, adaptive readout learning, or open-domain reasoning.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.repaired_relation: byte-identical supported 0.5 current-row plus 0.5 overflow-row backoff for exact-pair support below 3

readout_refinement.motif_ranking: total decoded training occurrence count descending, then motif ID ascending
readout_refinement.ground_truth: class of the actual heldout terminal motif under the frozen training-only rank assignment
readout_refinement.distributional_answer: sum terminal probability mass over motifs in each frozen class and select maximum mass; ties select lower class index
readout_refinement.top1_projection_control: map terminal top-1 motif from the same repaired distribution to its frozen refined class
readout_refinement.explicit_readout_capacity_delta: 3 scalar class accumulators to 8 scalar class accumulators; fixed before heldout scoring

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes and all frozen depth-3 gain, depth-2 nondegradation, aggregation-control, per-source, and hidden-fraction thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and refined repaired depth-3 accuracy improves over refined baseline, but at least one nondegradation/control/hidden-fraction threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but refined repaired depth-3 accuracy does not improve over refined baseline.
classification_rules.invalid: Any sealed-parent, authority, source, split, representation, relation identity, readout assignment, fixed class-size, determinism, capacity, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.

validity_criteria: Exact sealed readout-ceiling attribution parent and North Star identities match.
Fresh READY_RESEARCH is bound to this exact preregistration and external manifest.
The learned 512-motif representation, baseline relation, repaired relation, support threshold, runtime cap, and horizons are byte-identical in semantics to the sealed attribution experiment.
The eight class assignments are computed only from training-prefix motif occurrence ranks and frozen before any heldout scoring.
The readout delta is explicit and bounded: exactly eight fixed scalar class accumulators and 512 fixed assignments; no adaptive readout learning is permitted.
Heldout labels affect scoring only and never motif ranking, class boundaries, thresholds, relation state, or successor selection.
Duplicate complete probes are byte-identical and probability mass remains normalized within tolerance.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, relation-capacity growth, adaptive readout growth, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, repair rule, support threshold, rank rule, eight class boundaries, runtime cap, horizons, controls, 0.005 gain/control margins, 0.75 hidden-fraction ceiling, per-source floor, metrics, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: compose multiple training-frozen predicates over the refined repaired predictive state without changing relation capacity

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: attribute whether residual failure is class-boundary geometry, source specificity, or probability aggregation before any additional readout capacity change
